skill_name: Describe in 3 to 5 sentences the most important aspects of a topic.
workflow: Neural networks are computer algorithms that are inspired by how the human brain works. They are modeled after biological neural networks, which consist of interconnected neurons that are able to learn and recognize patterns. Neural networks create a mathematical model to take inputs and use them to calculate outputs.
